notablePrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Jumbo Cactuar and create 10,000 Treasure tokens.
